$comment: Cross-session progress ledger (the 'feature list' pattern from Anthropic's long-running-agents guide). Agents read it at session start (hook) and update status as work moves: todo -> in-progress -> pr-open -> merged, or blocked (resumes once the reason in notes is resolved), or closed (terminal: superseded, parked or not a bug; nobody picks it up). Keep entries one line; details live in the linked docs.
